messages:
alex: Heads-up — We’re running a regional failover + SLO burn loadtest this weekend to validate graceful-degradation policies and fallback routing. Window: Sat Apr 4 02:00–05:00 UTC. Expected noise: brief p99 spikes as we exercise fallback tiers. :warning:

oncall-bot: Scheduled maintenance event created: ID mf-2026-04-sre-failover. Pager notifications will fire 15m before start.

maya: Is the SLO adjustment already approved? which metrics will be ignored for the window?

alex: Yes, ops-manager signed off. We're adjusting p99 latency SLO exempt list for 02:00-05:00 UTC and temporarily suspending error-budget alerts for the 'best-effort' tier. Nothing changes for SLA-backed Dedicated customers.

jamie: Runbook for the rehearsal: 1) Start small failovers in us-west-2 -> measure routing. 2) Drain 10% of regional serving pods. 3) Monitor model-variant fallback rates, kvcache hitrate. 4) If p95 > 300ms for >5m -> abort and rollback routing.

sam: Confirming we'll pre-warm prefixes before drain? Need a quick warmup script for kv cache.

jamie: Yes — pre-warm plan attached in thread: 
`````
# prewarm prefixes
for prefix in /app/route/*; do 
  curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefetch?prefix=$prefix" &
done
```
Run 30m before window.

maya: Who’s on primary/secondary oncall for the window?

alex: Primary: jamie, Secondary: sam. Incident commander: maya. Ops-manager: @ops-manager on pagers.

ops-manager: Approved. Please post a short note to #status-redwood 1 hour before start and include the rollback checklist. :thumbsup:

jamie: Rollback checklist (quick):
- revert regional route weights to previous values
- abort ongoing drains with `kubectl annotate node` gate
- re-instate kvcache priming
- disable temporary SLO exemptions

alex: Final ask — if you own any model route that pins variants, confirm compatibility with fallback variants by EOD Fri. I’ll compile a list and DM teams that haven't replied.

oncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-04-04T01:45:00Z — 15 minutes until mf-2026-04-sre-failover.

sam: Acknowledged. added a quick smoke test to the check-in: send 50 requests at T-5m across routes, verify 99% success and <500ms.

alex: Thanks all — I'll publish the playbook and post to #status-redwood as requested. Keep chatter here for any last-minute flags
